title: Expected-Value Radar — which pre-token protocol is worth farming next

model.formula: implied_value_usd = tvl_usd x peer_multiple x momentum x breadth x launch_prob
model.peer_multiple: Median mcap/TVL of token-bearing protocols in the same category (min 3 peers, else the global median); capped to [0.02, 2.00].
model.launch_prob: clamp(maturity x staleness x category_prior, 0.005, 0.90); maturity = age_days / (age_days + 180); staleness = exp(-max(0, age_days - 900) / 2000); category_prior = 0.01 for CEX / Bridge / Canonical Bridge / Liquid Staking / Liquid Restaking / Restaked BTC, x0.35 for a version marker or wrapped/staked word in the name, else 1.
model.verdicts: FARM NOW: launch_prob >= 0.75. FARM: >= 0.60. WATCH: >= 0.35. PASS: below that, or a protocol that is already a product of a token that trades.
model.note: A protocol records no token when both gecko_id and symbol are null in the snapshot; that is the record, never proof it has none.
